app.title: Document Translator
correction.hint: Select a row below and edit its translation in the editor beneath the table. Use Bold/Italic/Underline (or Ctrl+B/Ctrl+I/Ctrl+U) to adjust formatting – edited rows keep their formatting too.
correction.title: Correct PDF translation
credentials.title: Credentials
exclude_footer.tooltip: Same as the header option, for text that repeats near the bottom of the page (e.g. a copyright line, page number).
exclude_header.tooltip: Automatically detects text that repeats near the top of most pages (identical, or only differing by a page number) and excludes it from translation. If nothing matching is found, nothing changes.
ico_mode.tooltip: Internal ICO document type only: excludes the page-1 metadata block from translation (Word: the block in front of the separator line; PDF: detected via anchor terms like "Issuer Address"/"Asset Matrix") - regardless of whether that block is actually found. Leave disabled for every other document.
image_correction.add_region_hint: Drag an area on the image to add a new box with its own text there.
image_correction.canvas_hint: In the image on the left you can drag a row's box to move it. Select the row to drag its bottom-right corner and resize it. Use Ctrl+scroll wheel or the zoom buttons to zoom in/out; the dialog can also be maximized.
image_correction.choose_file_label: Which file from this run should be corrected?
image_correction.hint: Select a row below and edit its translation in the editor beneath the table.
image_correction.manual_region_added: New box added - enter its translation in the editor.
image_correction.title: Correct image translation
inpainting_backend.hint: Determines how the translated area replaces the original text's spot in the image.
inpainting_backend.tooltip: Once the original text has been recognized, the area underneath needs to be filled in again. Box overlay simply covers it with a solid-colored box; classic CPU inpainting tries to automatically reconstruct the background underneath (e.g. a photo or pattern); AI inpainting (GPU, LaMa) does the same with a local AI model and usually gives the best results, but needs a sufficiently strong GPU.
inpainting_backend.unavailable: No sufficiently strong CUDA GPU was found for this method (see requirements-gpu.txt) - please choose a different rewrite method.

job.pdf_overflow_none: No block needed to grow or shrink while inserting.
job.result_cancelled_suffix: Note: the run was cancelled – this is a partial result, already-translated content was saved.
ocr_engine.google_vision.unavailable: No Google API key configured. Set one in Settings (the same key used for Google Translate, see README.md) or choose a different OCR engine.
ocr_engine.hint: Reads the text out of the image so it can be translated.
ocr_engine.paddleocr.unavailable: PaddleOCR is not installed (see requirements-paddleocr.txt) or choose a different OCR engine.
ocr_engine.tesseract.unavailable: Tesseract was not found on this system. Please install it (see README.md) - text in images cannot be recognized without an installed Tesseract.
ocr_engine.tooltip: The OCR engine extracts the text from the image before translation. Tesseract runs locally without internet access but is the simplest option; PaddleOCR also runs locally and detects connected paragraphs more reliably; Google Cloud Vision runs in the cloud (requires internet and an API key) and detects paragraphs most reliably.
ocr_engine.unavailable: This OCR engine is not available on this system.
